title: Baker Mayfield's Wife Sends Message to Brittany Mahomes After Receiving Gift - NewsBreak
text: Emily Mayfield, the wife of Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback, received a lovely gift from Patrick Mahomes' wife, Brittany Mahomes, on Wednesday. Mahomes sent Mayfield a PR package from OWYN, a popular beverage company that specializes in protein shakes and powders. The package came with three of OWYN Double Shot Protein Coffee Shakes, a Target gift card and a small tumbler. The box also had a personalized typed note from Mahomes. "I am so excited to share my latest obsession with you - OWYN Double Shot Protein Coffee Shakes that are now available at Target," the note said. "These shakes are a serious game changer for kick-starting my morning workouts or making it through the day as a busy mom." Mayfield posted a video of her opening the PR box on Wednesday afternoon, with Sammy Wilk's newest song "Mrs Perfect" as the audio and a caption that said "Getting me right" with a yellow heart written in the bottom right corner. The 34-year-old also tagged Mahomes and OWYN's official Instagram account. Kirby Lee-Imagn Images Not only did Mahomes used to be a professional soccer player, but she has always shared with her followers how important fitness is to her. Beyond being a supportive wife and mother, she is also involved in philanthropic efforts around food allergies. For instance, it was reported that Mahomes and OWYN committed to donating $100,000 to FARE (Food Allergy Research & Education) back in December 2023. Meanwhile, Mahomes and Mayfield have seemed to build a strong friendship online , constantly supporting each other through Instagram stories and comments.
